summary: Compose equilibrium, pole table, point assembly and frequency solve in explicit point order, carrying EM sparse continuation state.

identity.direction: Declared inputs to named scientific outputs.
identity.definition: Native original for-loop default grids are retained without materialized-range rounding drift. Each point retains matrix and full solution; mode counts can vary without padding. EM initial shift wg0*wci updates from the previous growth-selected root; ES3D retains complete decimal carriers.
identity.model: Nonrelativistic Gaussian species; explicit finite-harmonic/rational approximation when applicable.
identity.geometry: Homogeneous plasma with background field along z; k=(kx,0,kz) where applicable.
identity.coordinates: Explicit ES dimensionless normalization or EM SI; complex frequency follows exp(-i omega t).
identity.boundary: Periodic/infinite homogeneous plane-wave response; finite numerical harmonic/pole representation explicitly declared.
assumptions: A numerical spectrum is not automatically a physically certified mode.

inputs.name: model
inputs.description: Select es1d, es3d or em frequency relation.
inputs.constraints: Explicit model selection; no implicit conversion between ES and EM deck conventions.

inputs.name: deck
inputs.description: Species table; None reads the packaged default for the selected model. ES1D columns q,m,n,T,vd. ES3D q,m,n,Tparallel,Tperp,vd. EM q/e,m/me,n,Tparallel,Tperp,vd/c.
inputs.units: ES dimensionless normalized quantities; EM n in m^-3, T in eV, mass in electron masses.
inputs.shape: Sx5 for es1d; Sx6 for es3d/em
inputs.constraints: Nonzero charge; positive mass,density,temperatures; EM S>=2 for declared second-species normalizers. Finite after float64 narrowing.

inputs.name: J
inputs.description: Number of rational Maxwellian Z poles.
inputs.constraints: ES1D2/3/4/8/12; ES3D/EM4/8/12. J12 is intentionally regenerated. Unsupported order raises; no fallback.

inputs.name: opt
inputs.description: ES1D table variant; None selects J4 variant2, otherwise variant1.
inputs.constraints: ES1D opt1 or2. Only J4/J8 distinguish variants; other model tables do not use opt.

inputs.name: N
inputs.description: Retained cyclotron harmonic index n=-N,...,N. None selects ES3D10 or EM2; ES1D does not use N.
inputs.constraints: Integer>=0 when relevant. Uniform EM k0 uses analytic gyro response independently of this cutoff, including N0.

inputs.name: B0
inputs.description: Signed background field along z; None selects ES3D1 or EM100e-9. ES1D has no field.
inputs.constraints: Relevant magnetized field finite and nonzero; no inferred unmagnetized substitute. ES3D Omega_s=B0*q_s/m_s.

inputs.name: points
inputs.description: Finite ordered wavevector tuples. None uses exact original for-loop iterates: ES1D .4:-.02:.01; ES3D kx .05:.1:5,kz0; EM kc/omega_pi .01:.02:1 at71degrees.
inputs.units: ES wavevectors dimensionless; supplied EM kx,kz in m^-1. EM default scan parameter kc/omega_pi dimensionless.
inputs.shape: P tuples of length1 for es1d; length2 for es3d/em
inputs.dtype: iterable of real tuples or None
inputs.constraints: ES1D k!=0; ES3D kx²+kz²>0; EM uniform kx=kz=0 supported. Input order and all per-point carrier records preserved; no padding of differing mode counts.

inputs.name: sp
inputs.description: Dense0 or shifted sparse1 for ES1D/EM; ES3D uses its qualified descriptor/interlacing path.
inputs.constraints: sp0 or1. Sparse frequency count follows solve_matrix default1; original shifted solve limitations still apply.

inputs.name: wg0
inputs.description: Initial EM frequency guess normalized by source wci=abs(Omega_second). Internal physical shift begins wg0*wci and updates from the preceding selected root. ES ignores this control.
inputs.constraints: Finite after complex128 narrowing. Ordered continuation state is owned by this call.

outputs.name: model
outputs.constraints: Returned only on successful constituent completion; preserve named scientific fields.

outputs.name: points
outputs.constraints: Returned only on successful constituent completion; preserve named scientific fields.

outputs.name: equilibrium
outputs.constraints: Returned only on successful constituent completion; preserve named scientific fields.

outputs.name: pole_table
outputs.description: Explicit pole family state and receipt.
outputs.constraints: Returned only on successful constituent completion; preserve named scientific fields.

outputs.name: spectra
outputs.description: Per-point matrix and complete solution, including decimal carriers/classifications where applicable.
outputs.constraints: Returned only on successful constituent completion; preserve named scientific fields.

outputs.name: wg
outputs.description: Final EM selected frequency guess, zero for ES.
outputs.constraints: Returned only on successful constituent completion; preserve named scientific fields.

outputs.name: mode_axis
outputs.constraints: Returned only on successful constituent completion; preserve named scientific fields.

preconditions: Constituent inputs finite and representable in declared numeric ports.
supported: Finite ordered supplied grid or original default grid.
State owned by the invocation; sequential sparse continuation.
excluded: No hidden reordering or implicit arbitrary iteration.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Constituent model/deck/table/point/solver guards propagate; supplied point tuples must fit the selected model.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: NativeExecutionError retains its NativeReceipt for unavailable, failed or timed-out owned-scratch execution; no checkout/network fallback. Python/SciPy constituent failures propagate.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: First failed point/constituent stops the ordered scan; descriptor/eigen/interlacing qualification errors are not converted to successful roots.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No successful result is returned if this operation raises; no partial scientific return is promised.

example.description: Two ordered ES1D points with explicit pole family.
example.code:
from scirel.kinetic.pdrk.workflows import ordered_rational_spectrum
r = ordered_rational_spectrum({'model': 'es1d', 'J': 4, 'points': [(0.2,), (0.3,)]})
assert len(r['spectra']) == 2
example.expected: Two point states in caller order, with matrix/solution records and explicit mode-axis metadata.

scope: Source-absent installed own scientific package; exact package/resource closure.
All12 APIs, independent canonical and separate held-out response, axis and signed-wavevector gates.
Full perpendicular ES3D N10/J8 original50-point default with independent weak-coefficient and Decimal offset checks.
Flattened scientific input ports documented independently of the thin wrapper(inputs) calling convention.

Finite-J/finite-N physics must be qualified for a new requested regime.
Earlier fixed-distance approach-to-axis ancillary assertions remain failed records; exact-axis/direct-response gates are separately qualified.

nodes.description: Read packaged species table only when caller deck is None.
Use caller deck when provided, otherwise the actual packaged deck.
Initialize the selected model physical scales.
Select the source-family rational pole data.
Merge equilibrium.state and table.state, preserving model units; extract cwp/wci only for EM.
When points is None, run the packaged default_coordinates relation and retain exact source for-loop iterates; project ES tuples or EM kj.
For default EM only, map each exact native kj at fixed 71 degrees through the actual coordinate relation.
Use the stored default 71-degree direction only for the default EM grid.
Materialize ordered tuples, initialize EM guess=wg0*wci (ES guess=0), then select each point using bounded carry state. Supplied points bypass default conversion.
ES1D projects tuple[0] to k; ES3D/EM project tuple[0:2] to kx/kz; preserve merged scientific state and harmonic control.
Build the actual model matrix or Harris coefficient/carrier state.
Use full ES3D point state or ES1D/EM state.M; pass sp, use default nw=None and current guess.
Solve and retain every returned branch-conditional diagnostic/carrier.
Collect only fields actually returned by the selected branch; never synthesize absent conditional keys.

Append actual matrix wrapper and complete solution in point order; EM updates guess from solution.wg after every EM point, while dense solver ignores its shift. Return full scan only after exhaustion.

execution.mode: Explicit Python scientific composition; ordinary data edges form a DAG and any iteration is separately bounded.
execution.ordering: Conditional default deck -> equilibrium; pole table -> merged state; conditional exact grid/EM conversion -> ordered per-point assembly -> solve -> full result append and bounded carry.
branches: Default deck/grid only for None; supplied Cartesian EM points already have SI units.
ES3D uses its descriptor/interlacing branch and may return varying mode counts.
EM guess updates every completed point; only sp=1 consumes it as a shift.
execution.state_ownership: Invocation owns scratch, point index, carried guess and completed results; caller mappings are not mutated.
execution.failure_propagation: First constituent failure propagates without a successful graph result.

feedback.state: Finite point index, accumulated matrix/solution records and complex carried guess.
feedback.initialization: Materialize supplied or exact source default tuples; index=0, records=[], EM guess=wg0*wci, ES guess=0.
feedback.update_order: Assemble current point, solve and qualify, append complete result, update EM guess even for dense mode, then advance point.
feedback.continue_when: Another tuple remains; sparse EM uses the carried shift, dense ignores it.
feedback.stop_when: All finite tuples consumed or first constituent failure.
feedback.iteration_bound: Exactly the finite materialized point count; no point reduction or padding.
feedback.nonconvergence: Propagate failure without appending/advancing an unsuccessful point.
